# ANALYSIS: STAGE1_BACKTEST_J_DAYS

**Filed:** 2026-08-24  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** analysis  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Running a Stage-1 backtest with walk-forward out-of-sample and real-fills on the three J winner days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) will quantify the true edge_capture of the current engine and any proposed changes, ensuring OP-16 edge_capture >= 771.

## Mechanism

We will run the existing engine logic (or a candidate's logic) over the full 16-month dataset, compute walk-forward OOS performance, and then isolate the P&L on the three J anchor days using real OPRA fills (simulated with realistic slippage). We will compute edge_capture as sum(engine_pnl_on_J_winners) - sum(max(0, engine_loss_on_J_losers)). The walk-forward OOS will be performed by splitting the data into expanding windows (e.g., train 12 months, test 4 months, rolling) and ensuring OOS Sharpe > 0.7. Real-fills check will compare BS-sim vs real OPRA on the top 3 J days; we require diff < ±20%.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline.  
2. **Sample bias:** We will use the full 16-month dataset (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) as available in the OPRA cache; selection is deterministic (all days). Overfit risk mitigated by walk-forward OOS and real-fills validation.  
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (will compute walk-forward OOS Sharpe and ensure >=0.70).  
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (will compare BS-sim vs real OPRA on top 3 J days).  
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day could be a large loss on a J loser day if engine misfires; max drawdown from historical; blow-up scenario if engine takes excessive risk on volatile days.  
6. **Concentration:** We will compute concentration after backtest; unknown until performed.
